units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 37a:12">Ab. Zar. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>אם מתי ג׳</he> the mere formula ‘If I die’ (without qualification).
<cite ref="Yevamot 20a:17">Yeb. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>לא תעשה ג׳ הוא</he> it is merely a prohibitory law; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גְּרֵידֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 79b:18">Ib. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>חייבי לאוין ג׳</he> trespassers of a mere prohibitory law, opp. <he>לאוין דשאר</he> referring to incest.
<cite ref="Sotah 32b:8">Sot. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>אמירה ג׳</he> the expression <cite ref="A02060"><he>אמר</he></cite> not qualified by <cite ref="P00970"><he>ענה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 73b:13">Keth. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>טעות אשה אחת ג׳</he> a plain error concerning one woman (where you cannot say that the case may be considered as though concerning two different persons); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 14:25">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XIV, 25</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01393"><he>גְּרַר</he></cite>.]
